description: This is a Makefile fragment related to OpenWrt firmware image building. It defines variables, macros, and rules for building kernel images, filesystem images, and other firmware components for embedded devices. The file includes references to SDK tools, kernel build parameters, filesystem configuration, and device-specific build logic.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/Initramfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to build initramfs images using existing image build rules.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/MkuImage
methods.description: Defines a macro to create kernel images with mkimage, specifying architecture, load address, entry point, and image data file.

methods.name: Image/Build/squashfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to build a squashfs filesystem image with options for padding and optional SELinux labels.

methods.name: Image/Build/gzip/ext4
methods.description: Defines a macro to gzip compress ext4 images if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: Image/Build/gzip/squashfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to gzip compress squashfs images if enabled.

methods.name: Image/manifest
methods.description: Defines a macro to generate a manifest listing installed packages and optionally a CycloneDX SBOM.

methods.name: Device/InitProfile
methods.description: Initializes device profile variables such as title and descriptions based on device specifics.

methods.name: Device/Init
methods.description: Initializes various device-related variables, paths, image names, and build parameters.

methods.name: Device/Build
methods.description: Coordinates the build process for a device, including kernel, filesystem images, and associated artifacts.

methods.name: Device/DumpInfo
methods.description: Outputs populated device profile information, including titles, packages, and supported devices.

methods.name: Device/Dump
methods.description: Calls DumpInfo for various alternative device titles if they exist.

methods.name: Device/Check
methods.description: Verifies device profile and sets build targets accordingly.
